scope: Local synthetic observations; no production or external time calibration

facilities.hypothesis: Kernel exposes parseable PSI/vmstat and optional delegated cgroup facilities
facilities.success_condition: Present files parse; missing capabilities are recorded explicitly
facilities.refutation_condition: A present PSI file cannot be parsed
facilities.reason: Availability only; no induced pressure, OOM, reclaim, controller change, or child migration

anonymous.hypothesis: Private anonymous/file/shared memfd map increases its own resident class
anonymous.success_condition: Quiescent child rollup class rises by >=80% of touched mapping bytes
anonymous.refutation_condition: Complete rollup class rises by less than 80%
anonymous.reason: PSS equals RSS for these singly mapped owned pages. status/statm are approximate; reads are sequential. Timing is local, not a universal ranking.

guard.limitation: Instant guard, not a reservation; hidden ancestor limits may be unknown

before.statm_unit: pages; comparisons above multiply by page_size_bytes
